own_solution.law: Coulomb's law with equal charge sharing on contact

notes: Base 16 mN agrees. R answers checked: 5.76e-3 N m^2 /(0.60+q)^2 gives 10.5186 (q=14 cm), 7.78799 (26), 5.22449 (45) mN. In pass 1 I labelled the radius K (point-charge regime); the authors' C (sharing in proportion to capacitance, which cancels for equal radii) is also a sound reading, since the radius enters the sharing relation and cancels; I accept C. Radii up to 4 cm remain small against 30-60 cm with the point-charge model stated. Minimal pairs T0EF1/TFAEF (earlier experiment vs afterwards) and TA88E/T2BDE (glass rods vs spheres) share 26 cm; numeral-free twins match. TFAEF's past tense 'Afterwards' is slightly less direct than T2BDE but unambiguous enough.
